name: codex-turn-loop-orchestrator-convergence
title: Codex turn loop and orchestrator convergence
description: Converge NovusAI chat core toward one codex-style turn loop, tool payload contract, budget owner, and stop-condition owner.
creator: yudi
notes: This workstream lands after capability-pack, page-workflow, and thread-memory owner contracts are stable so the core turn loop can stop carrying transitional glue. 2026-04-21 audit follow-up: `AgentChatCommandService` now imports `ExecutionDispatcher` / quota / stats owners directly instead of routing live chat through `agent_chat_service` compat re-exports, and stream completion/error persistence now calls the canonical `ConversationService.persist_stream_*` contract directly instead of probing for old-shape methods and keeping inline legacy fallback implementations in the orchestrator path.
